topic: 3D build story: a rotary washing line that becomes a wind tower with a tumble dryer on top
taste: One structure; every step has a spoken reason, is attached, and stays on screen. Our own world and story.

claims.claim: A rotary washing line stands in a ground socket set in a hole in the lawn.
The socket is set in quick-setting concrete (e.g. Postcrete), which is approved for rotary washing lines.
The socket is held level with a spirit level while the concrete sets.

rejected: exact hole depth (UK sources give 35-45 cm) - script says 'dig a hole'
